title: CS daily scratchpad - Aisha Rahman - 2026-03-22
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick triage for today (notes to self).

Context: prep for upcoming QBRs and a few at-risk renewals. Mostly call/emaillist, quick check-ins, capture blockers. Informal - will move action items to linear if needed.

TODAY'S TOP PRIORITIES
- BlueLeaf QBR (2026-03-24 prep) - finalize deck + ask Tom for latency graphs by EOD today.
  - owner: me / Tom Nguyen (action: Tom to pull 90-day P95 token latency per route)
  - ask: include dedicated vs hosted baseline, any incidents in last 90d, embedding regression note
  - risk: renewal conversation on 2026-04-02 (at risk if no answers on billing spikes)

- FinServCo renewal (2026-04-15) - narrow renewal ask to dedicated capacity options and SOC2 timeline
  - FinServCo contact: Priya K (email: priya.k@finservco.com)
  - deck: include Private deployment options + KMS integration notes (security is main ask)
  - blockers: legal needs SOC2 letter (estimate: Q3) — escalate to security if we need a faster path

- Acme Retail - onboarding follow-ups (support backlog)
  - tickets: CS-7123 (payment tokens failing on v2 route) -> assigned to Lina; follow up by EOD for customer update
  - suggest patch: revert to v1 routing fallback until stable kernel rollout (internal proposal linked)

MEETINGS / CALLS
- 10:30 AM - BlueLeaf prep sync (Tom, Lina) - review charts + talking points (30m)
- 2:00 PM - FinServCo scoping call (with Solutions Eng) - confirm KMS/Network requirements (45m)
- 4:15 PM - Office hours drop-in (open slot for customers) - log any asks as follow-ups

QUICK CHECKLIST (today)
- [ ] Ask Tom for latency P95 by 5pm (BlueLeaf)
- [ ] Draft BlueLeaf QBR slide: incidents, performance, roadmap (my draft by 3pm)
- [ ] Email Priya K with SOC2 status + proposed timeline (cc: Legal)
- [ ] Follow up on CS-7123 ticket with Lina and update Acme Retail
- [ ] Create Linear tasks for any new action items from FinServCo meeting

NOTES / TALKING POINTS (for QBRs)
- Performance: highlight consistent P95 improvements after kernel tuning in Jan, show before/after for sample route (route: gen-text-large). Mention continuous batching and cache benefits.
- Reliability: show incident timeline (Incidents: 2026-01-12, 2026-02-06) with remediation notes; call out fallbacks and cross-region routing as part of reliability story.
- Cost / economics: show unit cost delta for hosted vs dedicated for their throughput profile; include Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching + quantization) as quick wins.
- Roadmap ask: confirm whether they want Dedicated or Private evaluation; propose 90-day pilot for Dedicated with SLA.

RISKS / BLOCKERS
- Legal signoff on SOC2 required by FinServCo - may delay renewal if not clarified. Action: escalate to security and legal for a short letter (ask: get an estimate by 2026-03-25).
- Support ticket CS-7123 reproducible steps unclear - need logs from customer and a repro from SRE. Action: Lina to request logs; I will offer a debug session time.

FOLLOW-UPS / OUTREACH (quick templates)
- BlueLeaf reminder (email): "Hi <Name>, quick follow-up on QBR deck — attaching latest perf slides and a few open Qs re: billing spike. Can we sync 10:30 tomorrow?"
- FinServCo intro (email to Priya + Legal): short note with SOC2 status + ask for any compliance exceptions
- Acme Retail support update: quick status with ticket link + ETA for fallback plan

SCRATCH: ideas to include in QBR decks
- small demo of latency breakdown (client->edge->model) with callouts to where batching helps
- ROI slide: show tokens / month -> cost -> projected savings with Dedicated vs Optimize tuning
- Customer success playbook: how we handle incidents, triage timeline, SLA expectations (one-pager)

OPEN QUESTIONS (to resolve)
- Can Security provide a SOC2 interim letter or timeline faster than Q3? (ask: Lina + Security)
- Is there a finance-friendly renewal promo we can offer FinServCo (6-month discount?) - loop in RevOps
- For BlueLeaf, what triggered the billing spike? Need PM context or product-side metric (linked artifact: github:infra/rls-392)

RANDOM NOTES / personal TODOS
- move BlueLeaf slides to shared Confluence QBR space (confluence:CS-QBR-template-4821) after review
- remind Tom about ingestion metrics (also want top 5 customer routes)
- document kernel rollout dates in the postmortem summary

END OF SCRATCHPAD

(Keeping this rough so can copy parts into the actual QBR doc. Will clean up once charts arrive.)
